title: Prosthetic and orthotic technician
summary: Turn a clinical design into a carefully made device.
explanation: Turn a clinical design into a carefully made device.

tasks.title: Shape
tasks.detail: Use a model and the prescribed design to form device components.

tasks.title: Assemble
tasks.detail: Join and finish parts while checking dimensions and workmanship.

tasks.title: Revise
tasks.detail: Work with the clinician to address fit or fabrication issues.

classroomConnection: A design has to become a physical object whose shape and materials suit its purpose.

title: Prosthetist
summary: Assess a person’s needs and evaluate a prosthesis with them.
explanation: Assess a person’s needs and evaluate a prosthesis with them.

tasks.title: Assess
tasks.detail: Discuss goals and collect measurements for an individual design.

tasks.title: Fit
tasks.detail: Evaluate a trial device and its alignment with the person.

tasks.title: Follow up
tasks.detail: Use comfort, movement and clinical observations to guide changes.

classroomConnection: A useful solution is judged by evidence from the person using it, not by appearance alone.

title: Prepress and print-production design
summary: Prepare artwork so a print process can reproduce it reliably.
explanation: Prepare artwork so a print process can reproduce it reliably.

tasks.title: Prepare
tasks.detail: Check layout, image detail and the supplied production files.

tasks.title: Translate
tasks.detail: Match the design to the print method, stock and finishing needs.

tasks.title: Proof
tasks.detail: Inspect a proof and communicate corrections before production.

classroomConnection: A screen preview and printed sheet use different materials and conditions.

title: Printing press operator
summary: Set up equipment and check the printed output throughout a run.
explanation: Set up equipment and check the printed output throughout a run.

tasks.title: Set up
tasks.detail: Choose the job and adjust the press for the required output.

tasks.title: Inspect
tasks.detail: Compare samples for colour, alignment and image quality.

tasks.title: Control
tasks.detail: Make routine permitted adjustments and document checks.

classroomConnection: Small changes in colour and alignment can change the quality of an entire batch.

title: Metal-recycling operations
summary: Receive and sort scrap so suitable material can move into a recovery stream.
explanation: Receive and sort scrap so suitable material can move into a recovery stream.

tasks.title: Identify
tasks.detail: Distinguish material categories and identify items requiring special handling.

tasks.title: Separate
tasks.detail: Keep grades and unwanted material apart using established procedures.

tasks.title: Record
tasks.detail: Maintain receiving and movement records with the yard team.

classroomConnection: Material identity and contamination affect what can be recovered; one test rarely tells the whole story.

title: Aircraft deicing technician
summary: Apply trained ground procedures to remove or manage frozen contamination on aircraft.
explanation: Apply trained ground procedures to remove or manage frozen contamination on aircraft.

tasks.title: Operate
tasks.detail: Position and operate deicing equipment under airport procedures.

tasks.title: Apply
tasks.detail: Use the required fluid/application procedure for the conditions and aircraft.

tasks.title: Communicate
tasks.detail: Coordinate with crews and record the operation.

classroomConnection: Materials, temperature, communication and inspection all matter in one time-sensitive system.

title: Glazier and window-installation work
summary: Fit glazing and window systems into a building opening.
explanation: Fit glazing and window systems into a building opening.

tasks.title: Measure
tasks.detail: Check dimensions, alignment and installation requirements.

tasks.title: Install
tasks.detail: Fit glazing/window components using appropriate supports and seals.

tasks.title: Inspect
tasks.detail: Check the completed installation and identify problems.

classroomConnection: The performance of a material depends partly on how it is joined to the rest of the system.

title: Blood-component production work
summary: Help turn collected donations into traceable blood components under controlled procedures.
explanation: Help turn collected donations into traceable blood components under controlled procedures.

tasks.title: Prepare
tasks.detail: Handle incoming products and follow the production workflow.

tasks.title: Track
tasks.detail: Keep identity and processing records linked to the product.

tasks.title: Store
tasks.detail: Maintain the prescribed handling and storage workflow.

classroomConnection: Separating material is not enough; its identity and handling history must remain reliable.

title: Medical laboratory technologist
summary: Perform laboratory testing within a clinical quality system.
explanation: Perform laboratory testing within a clinical quality system.

tasks.title: Test
tasks.detail: Prepare samples and operate validated testing processes.

tasks.title: Check
tasks.detail: Examine controls and results for technical quality.

tasks.title: Document
tasks.detail: Record and communicate results within the laboratory’s professional scope.

classroomConnection: A result is useful only when the method, controls and sample identity are trustworthy.

title: Valve service technician
summary: Inspect, repair and test valves used to control or relieve process flow.
explanation: Inspect, repair and test valves used to control or relieve process flow.

tasks.title: Inspect
tasks.detail: Assess condition and investigate a valve’s reported behaviour.

tasks.title: Service
tasks.detail: Carry out permitted repairs and reassembly.

tasks.title: Test
tasks.detail: Use approved test equipment and document the result.

classroomConnection: A component must be tested under appropriate conditions before its behaviour can be trusted.

title: Electrician
summary: Build and check electrical installations using drawings, standards and trade procedures.
explanation: Build and check electrical installations using drawings, standards and trade procedures.

tasks.title: Read
tasks.detail: Interpret drawings and identify the intended circuit connections.

tasks.title: Install
tasks.detail: Fit and connect components using approved methods.

tasks.title: Verify
tasks.detail: Carry out permitted inspections and tests and document issues.

classroomConnection: A circuit diagram describes intended behaviour; installation and verification connect that model to a real system.

title: Jewellery designer
summary: Translate a client’s ideas into a design that can be reviewed and made.
explanation: Translate a client’s ideas into a design that can be reviewed and made.

tasks.title: Listen
tasks.detail: Clarify the intended use, dimensions, materials and appearance.

tasks.title: Model
tasks.detail: Use sketches or CAD to communicate the proposed piece.

tasks.title: Review
tasks.detail: Use a render or prototype to discuss changes before production.

classroomConnection: A prototype tests the relationship between a digital idea and a physical object.

title: Beekeeper
summary: Observe colonies and plan their care around local conditions.
explanation: Observe colonies and plan their care around local conditions.

tasks.title: Observe
tasks.detail: Record colony condition, food resources and seasonal indicators.

tasks.title: Assess
tasks.detail: Use appropriate sampling and records to investigate changes.

tasks.title: Plan
tasks.detail: Adjust the seasonal work plan and monitor what happens next.

classroomConnection: Decisions about a living system depend on observations over time, not one isolated reading.
